of consolidated bonds.  Consolidated  
bonds issued by the 12 Federal land

istered consolidated bonds of all issues

lost, stolen, destroyed, mutilated or de­
faced consolidated bonds or coupons.

hereafter in force, and the regulations  
of the Treasury Department, now or  
hereafter in force, governing relief on  
account of the loss, theft, destruction,  
mutilation, or defacement of United

the Treasury Department, now or here­

bonds.

partment, now or hereafter in force,  
with respect to securities of the United  
States, and coupons of such securities.

vidually.  Whenever it appears by clear

est-bearing bond or any coupon thereof
